topic: v21 is the best single artifact: NORMAL_FV on every DMA path
observations: decode has improved monotonically with the L2 work: 1.281 -> 1.316 -> 1.350 -> 1.356, all certified EXCEED
prefill candidate time varies by about 7% between windows (0.0648-0.0699), so differences under that size are not improvements
the microbenchmark winner on the read path (NORMAL_LV, 2.35 TB/s standalone) made the kernel slower; only the gate can rank policy choices
attribution_note: a profiling pass during contention gave absolute times inflated for both sides (v21 94.6 us vs vendor 79.8 us) but still shows our DMA about 18% slower than the vendor, so the gap remains on the movement side
